items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Davante Adams (leg), Ladd McConkey (concussion), Dalton Kincaid (ribs, returned), Romeo Doubs (shoulder), Rashod Bateman (shoulder), Darnell Mooney (neck).
items.why: In-game injuries; Kincaid returned, McConkey out, others monitoring.
items.implication: Potential mid/late week absences or limited roles next.
items.opportunity: If Adams limited/out, more for other Rams WRs; McConkey already out benefits teammates.

items.text: Ladd McConkey ruled out with concussion after being evaluated for head injury mid-game.
items.why: Concussion suffered in game; ruled out.
items.implication: Chargers WR targets shift; short-term absence likely into concussion protocol.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Quentin Johnston and other Chargers WRs.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive with ankle. Browns only have Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime (recent PS sign) available in backfield.
items.why: Ankle injury; only one practice this week; pregame workout led to out.
items.implication: Browns RB committee thin; low-volume committee for remaining backs.
items.opportunity: Carries and snaps to McLaughlin/Estime in limited committee.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive (groin). Tyjae Spears active for Titans.
items.why: Groin injury added Friday as Q; ruled inactive.
items.implication: Colts TE streaming options open; Titans RB Spears gets opportunity.
items.opportunity: TE targets/routes to other Colts pass-catchers; Spears carries/snaps.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore is inactive; Josh Palmer is active.
items.why: Shoulder injury; no early word then ruled inactive.
items.implication: Bills WR depth thins; Palmer and others absorb targets.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to remaining Bills WRs including Palmer.

items.text: Caleb Williams is active and back under center for Bears.
items.why: Full participant in practice; cleared from hamstring.
items.implication: Bears offense returns to starter QB; pass game unlocks.
items.opportunity: Full snap share and passing volume for Williams and supporting cast.

items.text: Chris Olave and Alvin Kamara both active for Saints.
items.why: Illness for Olave, back for Kamara (returned previously); expected then confirmed.
items.implication: Saints skill players at full strength.

items.text: AJ Brown and TreVeyon Henderson both officially active for Patriots; Brown returning from activation.
items.why: Ankle issues but expected/likely then confirmed active; Brown activated to 53.
items.implication: Patriots near full health on offense.

items.text: If starting a Giants RB still prefer Cam Skattebo for explosiveness and TD chance vs NO, but riskier now as more flex than RB2 (updated RB28). Was on preseason hate list for reason. Najee RB33.
items.why: Role change after fumbles; still has upside but elevated risk.
items.conflict: Conflicts with pure usage/efficiency data favoring committee shift.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts out indefinitely (IR with blood clot); Tanner McKee starting. Also AJ Brown back, Caleb returns, Baker up in air next week.
items.why: Superficial blood clot; placed on IR.
items.implication: McKee long-term starter; Eagles pass game adjusted.
items.opportunity: Continued targets to DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks if healthy.

items.text: Cam Skattebo currently 37th of 43 RBs in rush yards over expected and has 4 fumbles (1 lost). Expectation of larger Najee Harris role with Skattebo downgraded but still in mix; all 4 Giants RBs active.
items.why: Poor YOE efficiency and multiple fumbles prompting role change per sources.
items.implication: Riskier flex start; reduced snap/carry share expected.
items.opportunity: More carries/snaps to Najee Harris and committee mates Tracy/Singletary.

items.text: Weekend summary: GTD Judkins/Warren/Evans/Kirk; Expected Caleb/Olave/Kamara/AJB/Henderson/Metcalf/Freiermuth/Sadiq; Not expected Deebo/Croskey-Merritt/Tucker; Activated Jaydon Blue.
items.why: Compiled practice/report statuses heading into Sunday.
items.implication: Core tracking for start/sit and projections docks.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries for not expected: depth players; full roles for expected.

items.text: With Huntley under center expect run-heavy BAL vs CLE; all-in on Andy Reid home off bye - Walker fresh. Jaylen Warren among hottest RBs.
items.why: Script and coaching favor run volume; recent form for Warren.
items.implication: Strong start candidates in favorable spots.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries, goal-line, two-minute for these RBs.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams (RB5) vs ARI for elite recent usage and soft run D; also Javonte Williams goal-line role @GB and Rhamondre vs NYJ.
items.why: Volume, goal-line work, and defenses leaking vs run.
items.opportunity: High carry/red-zone shares in positive scripts.

sourceNotes.note: Sunday AM injury summary gold (GTD/Expected/Not/Activated); late injuries watch (Adams/McConkey/Kincaid); show schedule/projections hub. Core status tracking. Updated via Levitan on Judkins/Warren out, Spears active.
Player-specific: Judkins inactive + depth (McLaughlin/Estime only); Warren out/Spears active; Skattebo YOE 37th + 4 fumbles amid rotation; no early DJ Moore word; quoted ETR + updated projs.

Per-player: Skattebo still start but riskier flex RB28 post-rotation (prefer Najee over DK sometimes); Warren streamers Juwan/Freiermuth/Higbee; loves run-heavy scripts for Walker/Jaylen Warren; Happy Hour covering Judkins/Warren/Cam-Najee.
Primary real-time actives/inactives: Judkins/Warren out; Caleb/Olave/Kamara/Sadiq/Lane/Dowdle active; Spears active; DJ Moore later inactive; McConkey out mid-game concussion.
Corroborated: Kamara/Olave expected then active; Henderson/AJB likely then active; Judkins pregame then out; DJ Moore out; McConkey out; broader QB/injury context including Hurts out indefinitely.
